name: OANDA v20 REST API (practice account)
rate_limits: About 100 requests a second on a persistent connection and 2 new connections a second (source: https://developer.oanda.com/rest-live-v20/best-practices/). Max 5,000 candles per request (search summary only).
history_start: Unverified; candles go back many years for major pairs.
what_it_has: Live streaming prices, historical candles with bid, ask and mid, and full order placement on a free demo account (api-fxpractice.oanda.com).
simple: A pretend trading account at a real currency broker. A program can see real prices and place fake trades.
license_terms: Standard OANDA account and API terms; we did not read the data redistribution terms. Treat as personal use only.
quality_notes: Prices are OANDA's own quotes with its spreads, not the interbank market. Demo accounts may close after inactivity (third party report, unverified). The practice endpoint returns 401 without a token (tested).

relevance.reason: Intraday FX with real spreads and paper trading in one free account.
